rules.rule:
FoundationScale doctrine rules (blocking when violated):

## Measured-or-refused
- Any new capability, metric, or claim in code or docstring must be either MEASURED by an attached evidence path or loudly REFUSED/UNMEASURED. Flag: a happy-path claim with no measurement hook, no refusal arm, and no VACUOUS/abstain channel.
- An abstention or UNMEASURED arm must never be silently converted into a pass, a zero score, or a default value downstream.

## Exit-code contract
- Training/verification paths may exit only with 0/5/95/96. Flag any sys.exit / SystemExit / torchrun boundary value outside that set, or any catch that launders a known verdict into a bare nonzero.

## No silent fallback
- A configured-but-absent capability must refuse by name; falling back to defaults (dtype, device, objective, topology) without a _mark/refusal line is a defect.

## Comments
- Do not add narration-only comments; comments here state measured history or doctrinal rationale. A comment claiming behavior the code no longer has is a defect (stale-doctrine class).

Gate-plane rules (blocking when violated):

## Vacuity
- A gate returning PASS/ok over Coverage.none / checked=0 is a defect; the enforced-VACUOUS path exists for exactly this.
- New gates MUST declare context_type and controls() (>=1 MUST_FIRE). A missing MUST_FIRE means the detector is unproven.

## Registry integrity
- Gate ids are assigned exactly once per class; inventing ids outside the registry or weakening the duplicate-id raise is a defect.
- Refusal composition: a gate must not swallow a sub-gate's blocking verdict into a softer one.

RL-plane rules (blocking when violated):

## Group-relative honesty
- GRPO-family steps exist only with within-group reward variance; an all-equal-reward group must be skipped UNMEASURED, never stepped.
- used < offered must stay visible whenever rows drop (abstained rewards, undersized groups); hiding the drop is a defect.
- An abstained (unparseable/ambigous) row must never be scored 0.0.

## Objective resolution
- Refusals must name the algorithm's declared unmet requirement (read requirements().requires), not a generic shape message. The reference_policy requirement means a k3 term and requires a frozen reference policy.

## Generation hygiene
- Sampling knobs are declared by config, never inherited from a checkpoint's generation_config; do_sample defaults are a defect class here.

Train-plane rules (blocking when violated):

## Prologue purity
- Nothing from torch/transformers may be imported or touched before validation completes; consult loaded modules through sys.modules only. The poisoned-module tests enforce this.

## Run manifest
- Exactly one writer (effective rank 0) per run; other ranks abstain with a mark line. Writes are temp+fsync+Path.replace; in-place write_text or multi-rank emission is a defect.
- Exit COLLECTIVES: every substantive branch leaves via the rank-agreement path; a bare per-rank return is a rank-disagreement defect.

## Declared axes
- An axis the declared config sets but the engine cannot wire must refuse 96 before model load, never train as plain DDP under a misdescribed manifest.

Test-plane rules (blocking when violated):

- pytest.skip without a reason tied to an armed guard is forbidden (FS_FORBID_SKIPS=1 world): a skip is a failure by contract.
- A test double must stand in for the seam, not the behavior: fakes that reimplement the logic under test make the test tautological; flag those.
- Pinned strings must be justified by doctrine comments when pinning refusals/marks; an unexplained golden string that drifts with code churn is a smell, not doctrine.
- Never weaken an assertion to make a run pass; change requires evidence recorded in the PR.

Checks-plane rules (blocking when violated):

- Every gate tool ships --self-test with MUST_FIRE and MUST_PASS controls; a gate without a proven control may not report verdicts.
- Verdict taxonomy: 0 CLEAR / 5 RED / 95 UNMEASURED / 96 REFUSE -- a check exiting 1 on measured red, or computing a verdict from an absent input as success, is a defect.
- A gate whose inputs are stale must say UNMEASURED, not reuse the last green state.

Docs rules (blocking when violated):

- Any absolute number about the repo (LOC, file counts, test counts, gate counts, mutation tallies) must match the countables census; flag numbers in prose that the countables gate would RED. Fix via checks/countables_drift.py --fix, never by hand-waving.
- Claims about hardware results must carry estate+commit; 'works on H100/GB200' without a campaign row is an unmeasured claim.
- Never describe a REFUSED capability as available. Absent-by-design features say so with the refusal surface named.

Launcher rules (blocking when violated):

- The exit code reaching the caller must BE the verdict: wrapping torchrun/srun output so a red run reads 0 (or a refusal reads as a launch error) is the #72 defect class.
- Provenance and drain steps must complete before emitting a success marker; a marker before the drain is laundered green.
- GPU visibility assertions must use SLURM_STEP_GPUS/cgroup evidence, never sacct AllocTRES as the oracle.
